remarks:
Welcome to 97 Brinton Street, a Cape Cod single-family residence located in Buffalo’s University District. This 3-bedroom, 2-bath home offers a comfortable and inviting layout highlighted by beautiful hardwood floors throughout. The generously sized living room provides plenty of room to relax or entertain, while the standout primary bedroom features its own full bathroom and walk-in closet.

Major improvements include a complete tear-off roof replacement in 2019 and a new hot water tank installed in 2021. The home also features central air and a full basement offering additional storage and flexibility.

Outside, enjoy a fully fenced backyard with a rear deck that’s perfect for gatherings, entertaining, or relaxing outdoors. The property also includes a detached 1-car garage and two additional storage sheds.

Conveniently located approximately 5 minutes from UB South Campus, with shopping and other neighborhood amenities nearby, this Cape Cod single-family residence offers a great combination of comfort, functionality, outdoor space, and valuable updates.
